## Checklist

PRs are merged as submitted. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/foundryvtt-dcc/dcc/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

- [ ] One issue or feature per PR, with no unrelated changes
- [ ] `pnpm run check` passes
- [ ] Tests that asserted the old behavior are updated; new tests follow [Keep tests proportionate](https://github.com/foundryvtt-dcc/dcc/blob/main/docs/dev/TESTING.md#keep-tests-proportionate)
- [ ] Up to date with `main`; doesn't conflict with my other open PRs (combined or stacked if they touch the same files)
- [ ] New user-facing text is localized and translated in every `lang/*.json`
- [ ] No `version.txt` bump
- [ ] Substantial AI assistance is disclosed (tool named)
